evidence.quote: Meld je aan voor de opleiding via Studielink.

notes: Teaching language is Dutch only, based on the programme page. Tuition fee €10,308 is a general institution-wide non-EEA institutional fee; the pages do not state a programme-specific fee. No language proficiency requirement was found. Intake: start month September, but no day/month/year date is given, so only startDate null is shown with the 'Startmaand September' quote.

note.fr: Vérifiez que votre diplôme (baccalauréat marocain) est accepté ; les pages ne listent que havo, vwo, mbo-niveau 4, hbo-propedeuse et wo-propedeuse. Contactez Student Support pour l'instroomcoördinator.
note.en: Check that your diploma (Moroccan Baccalauréat) is accepted; the pages only list havo, vwo, mbo-niveau 4, hbo-propedeuse and wo-propedeuse. Contact Student Support for the instroomcoördinator.

evidence.quote: Neem contact op met Student Support en vraag naar de instroomcoördinator.

note.fr: Les candidats non-EEA doivent postuler avant le 1er mai et payer les frais de scolarité avant le 15 juin ; vérifiez ces dates et le paiement.
note.en: Non-EEA applicants must apply by May 1st and pay tuition fees by June 15; check these dates and payment.

evidence.quote: Students with a non-EEA nationality are required to apply by May 1st and to pay their tuition fees in full prior to the start of the academic year.
